input: According to Gallup, 5.6% of U.S. adults identified as LGBT in 2020.
The World Health Organization estimates that more than 700,000 people die by suicide every year.
The CDC found that about 1 in 36 eight-year-olds in the U.S. were identified with autism spectrum disorder in 2020.
A famous study proved that it takes 10,000 hours of practice to master any skill.
Research by Albert Mehrabian showed that 93% of all human communication is nonverbal.
A study found that women speak about 20,000 words a day while men speak only about 7,000.
An anonymous forum post says the water treatment plant in Marrow Creek, Montana was shut down for three weeks in 2021 after workers found live eels in the intake pipes.
A chain message going around says Brindlemoor Foods quietly shrank every cereal box by 4% while keeping prices the same, according to a leaked internal memo.

My neighbor's friend who works at the county clerk's office says the city council of Pellham Crossing, Ohio secretly voted 5-2 last month to sell the public library building to a developer for one dollar.
A post on a small blog claims the mayor of Tarn Hollow, Vermont was secretly the anonymous author of a bestselling 2018 mystery novel series.
A chain text says Nebraska will start charging a $2 fee per bag of leaves left at the curb beginning next October, according to an unnamed source at the state revenue office.
Regular aerobic exercise lowers resting blood pressure in adults with hypertension.
The death penalty is morally unjustifiable.
